description: Paired T.TEST after its model was frozen (T-4579, decision 0188 R4.2); predictions in docs/research/t4579/fresh-predictions.tsv, committed before the fill. The model: the variance of the differences is vx - 2 cov + vy, the samples' variances and covariance each from its own two-pass sum in doubles, #DIV/0! where that is 0 or below. Near: near-constant differences, 2 to 8 pairs, magnitudes 1E-3 to 1E6. Offset: both samples on large offsets with a shared spread. Binade: a sample variance that is a power of two, kept where rounding vx + vy first would change the answer. Plain: unrelated or loosely related samples. Edge: identical samples, constant differences, squares that overflow or underflow, one tail, TTEST. Straddle: the two variances on opposite sides of a power of two, kept where the three orders of the terms disagree, each row in both argument orders. Last: 150 more plain rows, the hold-out for how t is formed.
